item.title: Analysis of degradation in perovskite solar cells through physics-based machine learning
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Kjeld O. Jensen, Gemma Giliberti, Aldo Di Carlo, Will Clarke, Giles Richardson, Taylor Blackwell, Petra J. Cameron, Alison B. Walker
arXiv:2608.10691v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Degradation in lead halide perovskite solar cells is analysed by inverse modelling of published measurements of characteristics of a single solar cell at ages 0, 90, 280, 480 minutes. We employ machine learning to deduce distributions of material parameter values and hence the physics linked to measured changes. Bayesian parameter estimation is coupled with drift diffusion simulations using the IonMonger code combined with an optical model. We accurately replicated measured changes in device performance with age through variations in model input parameters. Our key result is that degradation is influenced by correlated changes in the concentrations and diffusion coefficients of mobile ions and by interface recombination at large mobile ion c…

item.title: Physics-Informed Machine Learning in Prognostics and Health Management: A Systematic Literature Review
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Christopher Braun, Julian Raible, Marco F. Huber
arXiv:2608.10047v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In modern industry, keeping complex systems reliable, safe, and efficient hinges on Prognostics and Health Management (PHM). Machine Learning (ML) has largely driven advancements in diagnostics and prognostics, yet purely data-driven models face inherent limitations, such as poor generalization, an inability to infer causal relationships, and a lack of interpretability. Physics-Informed Machine Learning (PIML) helps mitigate these limitations by incorporating prior physical knowledge directly into the ML pipeline, thereby fostering growing interest in its application to PHM. This work investigates how PIML is being leveraged in the context of PHM through a systematic literature review of 212 studies. The review introduces a four-class classi…

item.title: CrPS₄中的各向异性磁振子自旋输运
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Krishnaraajan Sundararajan, Muhammad Zohaib, Yulia Kreminska, Sytze H. Tirion, Bart J. van Wees
本文在单斜范德华反铁磁体CrPS₄中，通过非局域几何观测到电激发和热激发磁振子自旋输运均具有显著晶体各向异性。沿晶体b轴的磁振子自旋电导率和自旋扩散长度明显大于沿a轴的对应值，热激发信号在b轴方向也显著增强。作者同时指出，从热激发非局域二次谐波信号中可靠提取扩散长度或自旋Seebeck系数存在困难，而电激发输运更适合表征本征晶体各向异性。

item.title: 通过空间分辨REXS成像Eu(Al0.4Ga0.6)4中竞争的共线与非共线自旋织构
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Fellipe B. Carneiro, Zéetény Bacsó, Kevin Allen, Aly H. Abdeldaim, Rebecca Scatena, Jaime M. Moya, Roger D. Johnson, Emilia Morosan, Alessandro Bombardi
本文利用共振弹性X射线散射研究Eu(Al₀.₄Ga₀.₆)₄零场磁自旋织构的不均匀性。空间分辨结果显示，两个磁转变来自两组近简并但不同的正交q矢量对，并对应空间分离的自旋密度波区域和螺旋区域。研究强调局域探针与整体探针得到的磁织构可能显著不同，空间分辨测量对于准确描述此类材料至关重要。

item.title: 掺杂FeSb₂中局域磁无序与交替磁性的竞争
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Enrico Di Lucente, Michele Simoncelli
本文从第一性原理研究Co或Cr掺杂FeSb₂中的能量景观和磁态，以解释实验中由掺杂诱导的交替磁金属或磁无序状态。作者结合DFT+U与Romeo基态搜索算法，并比较虚晶近似与显式掺杂超胞方法。模拟表明Cr掺杂体系基态为局域无序自旋补偿构型，而Co掺杂体系基态为交替磁态，并提出了研究候选金属交替磁体的计算流程。

item.title: 诱导挠电应变下三维铁电极化微结构的构建与极化不变量探测
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Sabarigresan Murugan, Vaishnavi S M, Ranjith Ramadurai
该工作发展了基于压电响应力显微镜的极化分量分辨成像方法，并结合结构与声子关联研究，用于解析铁电薄膜中晶粒取向、畴结构和弯曲应力驱动的相变。作者在 BCZT 薄膜中通过三点弯曲引入挠电应变并同步成像，尝试捕捉高压下出现的单斜相新极化不变量。该技术为多相多晶铁电体系的反演建模提供了实验基础。

item.title: 受驱d波交错磁体中拓扑相与磁光响应的Floquet工程
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Muzamil Shah
该文研究线偏振光Floquet驱动如何调控二维d波交错磁体的拓扑和磁光响应。无光场时体系具有自旋Chern相，而驱动通过偏振相关Peierls相破坏晶体反幺正对称性，引发自旋选择性能隙闭合和C=±1的Chern绝缘相。作者进一步用Kubo形式计算光电导、Faraday和Kerr旋转，指出线偏振光可用于自旋分辨能带反转、Chern数切换及无接触光学探测。

item.title: 径向涡旋中方位自旋波的巨大模式分裂
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Zhenyu Wang, Liangrui Li, Xuejuan Liu, Xiansi Wang, Ruifang Wang, H. Y. Yuan
径向涡旋是一种由界面 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用稳定的拓扑自旋织构。该研究发现，即使没有涡旋核，径向涡旋中的方位自旋波也会出现由 DMI 引起的巨大模式分裂，其强度可比传统涡旋核诱导的分裂大一个数量级。分裂随 DMI 常数和模式指数增加而增强，高阶模式可达数十 GHz，揭示了手性磁织构中稳健的模式分裂机制。

item.title: 范德华铁电体4H-SnS2中对光偏振敏感的晶体管作用
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Abhishek Bajgain, Rabindra Basnet, Subhashree Chatterjee, Alexander Samokhvalov, Ramesh C. Budhani
本文确立了SnS2中的室温铁电态，并通过比较中心对称2H相与极性4H相展示其对结构多型的敏感性。研究表明，4H-SnS2三端晶体管中的内建极化可被静电栅控以及线偏振光和圆偏振光显著调制。器件表现出极化控制的电输运与光响应特征，显示其在非易失存储和光铁电功能器件中的应用潜力。

item.title: 静止铁电体中的运动类比视界
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 David Galvez-Poblete, Rubén M. Otxoa, Alvaro S. Nunez, Sebastian Allende
该研究表明，铁电材料中极化梯度刚度的行波调制可在集体极化动力学中诱导有效流动。在局域近似下，小极化涨落即 ferron 满足带流动的有质量 Klein-Gordon 方程，从而形成可移动的类比视界。该机制不依赖介质的物理输运，并可通过外电场独立调节质量能隙，为具有有质量标量激发的类比引力提供可控平台。

item.title: 利用扫描NV磁力显微术对铁磁涡旋动力学进行纳米尺度成像
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jeffrey Rable, Jyotirmay Dwivedi, Nitin Samarth, Paul Stevenson, Arun Bansil, Swastik Kar
本文展示了利用扫描NV磁力显微术对介观坡莫合金结构中磁涡旋产生的静态场和微波场进行成像。该方法实现了约50 nm空间分辨率，并与微磁模拟高度一致，同时揭示了无序效应。研究还观察到涡旋核心附近40倍的微波场增强及其与无序相关的空间衰减，为磁振子器件研究提供了可及的高分辨平台。

item.title: 铁磁薄膜中斯格明子弦的振荡模式
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Eugene M. Chudnovsky, Dmitry A. Garanin
本文表明，由N个原子层构成的铁磁薄膜中的斯格明子弦具有挠曲振荡本征模。其本征频率满足给定解析公式，并通过最多十个原子层的离散微观自旋晶格模型以及有限温度下的斯格明子弦晶格数值验证。

item.title: 高自旋交替磁体中压磁性的量子机制
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Daisuke Yamamoto, Makoto Naka
本文利用flavor-wave方法研究具有易平面单离子各向异性的高自旋交替磁体中的压磁性。结果表明，高自旋集体模的量子涨落可为压磁响应提供微观起源，并且整数自旋与半整数自旋体系表现出显著差异。该研究将宏观压磁性与多极激发的低能演化联系起来，提出压磁性可作为探测高自旋量子动力学的手段。

item.title: 无自旋分裂能带的自旋分流器：一种可重构的交替磁织构
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Bin Xi, Jie Lu, Qiang Luo, Ken Chen, Jia-Wei Mei, Hong-Gang Luo, Jize Zhao
本文提出一种不同于传统交替磁材料的自旋分流机制，其功能不依赖晶格锁定的自旋分裂能带，而由受挫蜂窝磁体的非共面反螺旋基态及Q锁定的手性镜面对称实现。研究表明，在空穴掺杂下可实现无自旋分裂能带的自旋分流器，具有有限横向纯自旋流、零电荷Hall响应且无需自旋轨道耦合。三种简并Q取向的选择可使极化轴以精确120°步进旋转。

item.title: 反铁磁磁振子与赝表面等离激元之间的强耦合
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yamin Sun, Ka Shen, H. Y. Yuan
本文研究由反铁磁薄膜、介电间隔层和结构化金属表面构成的平面异质结构中，反铁磁磁振子与赝表面等离激元的杂化。解析求解Maxwell方程与磁化动力学方程表明，该体系可在太赫兹频段实现强磁振子-等离激元耦合，并在色散中表现为明显的反交叉。该平台更适合片上操控与集成。

item.title: Structural Distortions and Ferroelectricity in Antiperovskite Oxides with Tetrel Elements
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 He Zhu, Turan Birol
arXiv:2602.06324v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Antiperovskites share the same structure as perovskites, but allow completely different chemistries and nominal charge states of anions to be stabilized. This gives rise to many interesting phenomena, including septet superconductivity and topological crystalline insulating phases in these systems. Despite this, the work on the crystal structural trends in these compounds is more limited compared to perovskites. In this study, we consider the family of antiperovskite oxides with tetrel elements (Si, Ge, Sn, Pb) and alkaline earth metals (Ca, Sr, Ba), and perform a detailed study of their crystal structures using first principles density functional theory. We show how tolerance factor arguments can be constructed to predict their structur…

item.title: Magnetic ordering in VI3: a van der Waals material combining vastly different magnetic anisotropies
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 K. K. Pokhrel, S. Ray, N. Machavcova, A. Koliogiorgos, K. Carva
arXiv:2607.02759v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Among magnetic van der Waals materials, the vanadium trihalide family exhibits unique features. In particular, VI3 contains V atoms of two different types, as two energetically close electronic occupations can coexist in real samples. These types show strikingly different magnetic anisotropy, predicted to differ by more than an order of magnitude. The combination forms a distinctive magnetic system. VI3 also displays an unusual thickness dependence: the monolayer Curie temperature (TC) is higher than that of the bulk, contrary to the expectation that interlayer coupling reinforces magnetic order. Using atomistic spin-dynamics simulations informed by first-principles calculations, we investigate the critical temperature behavior from the…

item.description:

item.title: 形状、应变与自旋织构：现代磁性材料的三元组
item.description:
📚 Nature Nanotechnology
👤 Denys Makarov, Oleksandr V. Pylypovskyi, Rui Xu, Carmine Ortix
这篇综述讨论了形状、应变与自旋织构在现代磁性材料中的协同作用。文章关注非均匀应变、几何破缺的空间对称性以及由曲率诱导并经自旋织构介导的磁电耦合。其目标是阐明这些因素如何助力未来纳电子器件的实现。

item.title: A CMOS+X Spiking Neuron With On-Chip Machine Learning
item.description:

👤 Steven Louis, Matthew Blake Abramson, Hannah Bradley, Cody Trevillian, Gene David Nelson, Andrei Slavin, Artem Litvinenko, Jason Gorski, Ilya N. Krivorotov, Darrin Hanna, Vasyl Tyberkevych
arXiv:2512.03966v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present the design and numerical simulation of a spiking neuron in a proof-of-concept model of on-chip machine learning. Built within the CMOS+X framework, the spiking neuron consists of an NMOS transistor combined with a magnetic tunnel junction (MTJ). This NMOS+MTJ unit, when simulated in the industry-standard circuit simulation software ``LTspice'', reproduces multiple functions of a biological neuron, including threshold spiking, latency, refractory periods, synaptic integration, and inhibition. These behaviors arise from the intrinsic magnetization dynamics of the MTJ and do not require any additional control circuitry. By interconnecting the NMOS+MTJ neurons, we construct a model of an analog multilayer network that learns throu…

item.title: Deep reinforcement learning for separation control in turbulent wind-tunnel flow
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Sofia Avdiiv, Andre Weiner, Ben Steinfurth
arXiv:2608.10829v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work investigates Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) as a tool for model-free closed-loop active separation control in a fully turbulent wind tunnel flow over a one-sided diffuser. The agent controls an array of magnetic valves (on/off) that eject compressed air into the boundary layer, while the environmental state is reduced to the signal from a single wall-shear-stress sensor placed near the natural transitory detachment point. The control law is learned in real time using Proximal Policy Optimization. Compared to the standard learning design based on the weighted sum of all rewards following an action, we demonstrate that a horizon aligned with the convective time of the flow leads to faster convergence and a more robust control stra…

item.title: 超导氢化镧中的四极相变
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Abhishek Raghav (Institut de Minéralogie, de Physique des Matériaux et de Cosmochimie, Sorbonne Université, CNRS UMR 7590, Paris, France, Center for Emergent Matter Science, RIKEN, Wako, Japan), Kousuke Nakano (Center for Emergent Matter Science, RIKEN, Wako, Japan, Center for Basic Research on Materials, National Institute for Materials Science), Marco Cherubini (Institut de Minéralogie, de Physique des Matériaux et de Cosmochimie, Sorbonne Université, CNRS UMR 7590, Paris, France), Ryotaro Arita (Center for Emergent Matter Science, RIKEN, Wako, Japan, Department of Physics, The University of Tokyo, Japan), Michele Casula (Institut de Minéralogie, de Physique des Matériaux et de Cosmochimie, Sorbonne Université, CNRS UMR 7590, Paris, France)
该研究针对高压超导氢化镧 LaH₁₀ 的 Rbar3m 到 Fmbar3m 结构相变，利用团簇多极矩分析揭示其由氢子晶格中的四极 T₂g 序参量触发，并具有弱一阶性质。结合路径积分分子动力学和 MACE 神经网络势，作者发现序参量在相变处塌缩，并伴随光学 T₂g 声子的非连续软化。结果表明，低频四极畸变相关结构不稳定性可能是增强超氢化物超导性的关键因素。

item.title: 傅里叶回归模型中的费舍尔信息、训练与偏置
item.description:
📚 Machine Learning: Science and Technology
👤 Lorenzo Pastori, Veronika Eyring and Mierk Schwabe
受量子机器学习，尤其是量子神经网络研究兴趣增长的推动，本文考察基于费舍尔信息矩阵的评估指标能否预测模型训练与预测性能。作者利用一大类量子神经网络与傅里叶模型之间的等价性，分析有效维度与任务偏置之间的相互作用。结果表明，对于无偏模型，较高有效维度通常有利于训练和性能；而对于与任务对齐的有偏模型，较低有效维度在训练中可能更有益。

item.title: Toward nonlinear representations with Gaussian-splat manifolds for physics-informed learning
item.description:
📚 Nature Communications
👤 Xu Han, Kuangxu Chen, Rui Wang, Guanzhou Wei, Ligong Han, Han Gao
Nature Communications, Published online: 12 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76254-4 Simulating shocks and thin shear layers typically requires extremely fine computational grids. Here, the authors adapt mobile, stretchable Gaussian kernels originally developed in computer graphics to directly satisfy the governing equations, enabling sharp features to be captured with far fewer parameters than conventional numerical or neural-network-based solvers.

item.title: A Quantum Roadmap for Softmax Attention: Exact Born-Rule Analogs for Softmax Attention on the Probability Simplex
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Eric A. F. Reinhardt, Adam J. Hauser
arXiv:2608.11173v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The attention mechanism forms the foundation of many modern AI models such as the Transformer. In one subclass of problems where attention is used, inputs and outputs are bound to the probability simplex so that all outputs sum to one. In this setting, softmax attention admits an exact, component-by-component quantum realization. Attention scores are Hadamard-test statistics on block-encoded projections of amplitude-encoded inputs. The exponential softmax is the interior of a cosine-squared family generated by Born-rule measurement under an exact bijection, whose boundary expresses sparse attention with exact zeros at finite parameter values. The softmax temperature is a repetition count where post-selected measurement rounds realize discr…

item.title: 用于量子磁体中不确定性感知哈密顿量推断与实验设计的观测几何
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Roy Liu, Venugopal Ranganathan, David Dahlbom, Shizhou Xu, Tianyu Zhang, Yuan Ni, Daniel M. Pajerowski, Garrett Granroth, Thomas Strohmer, Matthew B. Stone, Andrew F. May, Mark D. Lumsden, Joshua J. Turner, Yongqiang Cheng, Zhantao Chen
该工作提出一种人工智能驱动框架，用于在量子磁体中进行具有不确定性感知的哈密顿量推断和自适应实验设计。框架结合哈密顿量条件神经替代模型、贝叶斯推断和观测几何，直接在物理参数空间中刻画实验数据对微观相互作用的约束。作者以 NiPS₃ 的粉末和单晶非弹性中子散射多模态测量为例，展示了可解释的哈密顿量推断、模态感知不确定性量化和实验设计能力。

item.description:

Furthermore, traditional quantum classifiers are constrained by the number of orthogonal basis states, limiting their capacity to accommodate a continually growing number of categories. item.title: Assessing fidelity-limiting factors and achieving single-qubit gate fidelity beyond 99.999% in driven silicon spin qubits
